writing.exampleCaption: &self borrows, so the caller keeps ownership.
writing.explanation: impl blocks attach constructors and methods to the type. The receiver spells out the ownership contract: self consumes the value, &self borrows it for reading, and &mut self borrows it for modification — so a method signature tells you what it will do before you read the body.
writing.feedback: &self or &mut self keeps the value usable after the call.
